title: Non-archimedean Monge-Ampère measures for toric metrics on subvarieties of toric varieties
summary: We study non-archimedean Monge-Ampère measures of toric metrics on closed subvarieties of toric varieties, after reducing, if necessary, to the minimal torus-orbit closure containing the subvariety. The measure vanishes on the toric boundary and is supported on the tropical skeleton. Our main result explicitly describes their local structure in terms of the tropical germ of the subvariety and the tropical Green function of the metric.
